[Stable_Diffusion_Prompt] is oriented towards the Pony models to generate images (asking with a quick reply on LLM Instruct Models, usually working, depends of LLM models)

"ooc: give me the Stable_Diffusion_Prompt of {{char}}"

(you can replace ooc by system, sometimes it's working)
*
So good luck, I hope you enjoy it and don't hesitate to give me feedback.
**
Please don't post it anywhere else without telling me about it before.**
